name: Voron 2.4 350 Rapido 0.4
printer_notes: Voron 2.4 350, Orbiter + Phaetus Rapido v1 (HF 0.4 nozzle), Voron TAP, Klipper. Accel/velocity limits mirror printer.cfg (max_accel 3000, max_velocity 300) - raise both here and in printer.cfg after input shaper calibration.
machine_start_gcode:
M190 S0 ; Stops the slicer from adding its own bed heat-and-wait (PRINT_START does it)
M109 S0 ; Stops the slicer from adding its own nozzle heat-and-wait (PRINT_START does it)
PRINT_START EXTRUDER=[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] BED=[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] CHAMBER=[chamber_temperature] SOAK={if filament_type[0]=="ABS" or filament_type[0]=="ASA" or filament_type[0]=="PC" or filament_type[0]=="PA"}20{else}0{endif} MATERIAL=[filament_type]
; SOAK is only used once heatsoak.cfg is enabled - see printer_data/config/heatsoak.cfg
